MŠK Žilina is a Slovak football club based in the town of Žilina, that is playing in the Slovak First Football League. Since the league inception in 1993, the club has won 7 titles and comes second in All-time table that makes them one of the most successful teams in the competition.\nThe club and their supporters alike are nicknamed Šošoni and play their home games in the Štadión pod Dubňom. Žilina won their most recent title in 2016–17 season.
